title: Year 9 end-of-year test: overview and sample questions
subject: English
unit: Summer 2: Year 9 mastery and readiness for the International GCSE
source: Written for english/y9 lesson 71 (Year 9 end-of-year test overview and sample questions (teacher-written, pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 71. The test has three sections. Use the samples to plan.

questions.q: Section A: How does the writer use language to show the river's recovery? (8 marks)
questions.a: Points on 'brown, slow and empty'; the list of volunteers' actions; 'leaping the weir'; the personified ending 'Rivers... remember how to be rivers'

questions.q: Section B: Compare how two poets present the cost of war. (20 marks)
questions.a: An integrated comparison with methods, context and a judgement

questions.q: Section C: 'Every town should have a volunteer day.' Write an article arguing for or against. (20 marks)
questions.a: Clear viewpoint, structured paragraphs, counter-argument, accurate writing
